note: Louisiana races on a ZIP 70820 (Baton Rouge) ballot, researched Oct. 24, 2026.

notes.text: Sen. Bill Cassidy lost the May 16 Republican primary; Letlow then beat Treasurer John Fleming in the June 27 runoff.
Projected votes assume about 1.38 million voters, close to Louisiana’s 2022 Senate turnout.
A Hart Research (D) poll from September (Letlow 48%, Davis 44%) is listed by Wikipedia, but its only source is a social media post, so it is left out of the average.
Davis says his campaign’s internal polling shows him 4 points behind. No pollster, dates or sample were released, so it is not in the average.

polls.note: 22% undecided. A campaign’s own poll; treat with caution.

earlyVote.label: first day
earlyVote.note: About 115,000 people voted on the first day of early voting. Black voters made up almost 32% of them, a larger share than in almost any election since 2008. Early voting runs through Oct. 27.
